sn22.66:1.2: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu …pe… bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.66:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyya’nti.
sn22.66:1.4: yaṃ kho bhikkhu, aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo’ti.
sn22.66:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsī’ti.
sn22.66:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante, aniccaṃ, tatra me chando pahātabbo,
sn22.66:2.6: viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ, tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.66:2.7: imassa khvā’haṃ bhante, bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmī’ti.
sn22.66:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.66:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu, aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.66:3.7: viññāṇaṃ aniccaṃ, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.66:3.8: imassa kho bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo’ti. atha kho so bhikkhu, bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā …pe…
sn22.66:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
